title: DOUBLE STRENGTH + SWING
why: First session on the new pair. Double front squat + press build strength, 16 kg swings bring the burn, easy Zone 2 to finish. Adapts once you start reporting.
warmup: Brisk walk 2 min · Halos 5/side · Body-pass 5/side · Goblet pry ×5 · Leg swings 10/leg · Shoulder dislocates ×10 · Ankle rocks 10/side · Priming swings ×12

kb.heading: PRIMARY · DOUBLE SQUAT + PRESS + SWING
kb.noteGreen: Circuit the three, minimal rest. Target 5 rounds. Squats/presses at 1–2 in reserve; stop swings when snap drops.
kb.noteYellow: Target 4 rounds, keep 2–3 in reserve everywhere. No grinding.
kb.altNote: EMOM 16 min — odd minutes: 5 double front squats; even minutes: 15 swings (16 kg).

run.desc: RPE 5–6 · full sentences the whole way (~105–123 bpm). Time on feet, not speed.

cooldown: Walk it down 1–2 min · Stretch 20–30s each: hip flexors, hamstrings, chest/shoulders, spinal twist.
